zh_cn.name: 饰物
zh_cn.description: 虽然可佩戴的物品的种类十分丰富，但并非所有东西都有其功能，有些戴上之后乍看起来并没有任何明显的功能。<br2/>尽管如此，你仍可以自行制作，或是找到一些注入了强大魔法的物品，并佩戴于身上。这些东西形态各异：戒指，护身符，抑或者是其他的形态。这些小玩意佩戴起来相当便利，并不会像重型盔甲或是剑那样给佩戴者带来过多负担。

en_us.name: Accessories
en_us.description: Many items, though wearable on one's own body, serve no apparent function at first glance.<br2/>Yet you can craft or discover things imbued with powerful magic that take shape of rings, or charms, or something else that is more convenient to carry around and doesn't burden its owner as much as heavy armor or a sword.

zh_cn.name: 盔甲
zh_cn.description: 尽管这个世界处处皆是美景，但在那至暗的角落中却也伏匿着众多危险。那些旅行者们若是没有准备一些保护应对的法子，那他们只会被这些危险吃干抹净，毫无生还的可能。<br2/>许多传奇工匠穷其一生于盔甲锻造，他们试图锻造出完美的盔甲。而你，毫无疑问，你会超越他们。

en_us.name: Armor
en_us.description: Despite all its beauty, this world has many dangers lurking in its darkest corners. Many can easily obliterate unaware traveler, if one doesn't have proper means of protection.<br2/>Many legendary blacksmiths dedicated their lives to attempts of creating perfect armor. You will, no doubt, surpass them all.

zh_cn.name: 酿造
zh_cn.description: 从远古时代以来，药水便已是人类巫师中的抢手货，而半神们却对药水之力不屑一顾：不断深入地研究药水构成、由原料带来的诸多麻烦事，在半神看来，区区药水之力不值得他们去做这些杂事。<br2/>但是，对于那些并不在意这些杂事的人而言，药水就是他们最为强大的工具：任其使用，效果也不赖。

en_us.name: Brewing
en_us.description: Though it was quite popular among human mages of the former eons, many demigods underlook the power of potion brewing, considering it not worth extensive investigation and all the bothering with ingredients.<br2/>But for those willing to give what it takes, potions can become the most powerful tools at their disposal.

zh_cn.name: 装饰物
zh_cn.description: 其实，有些你设计并制作出来的东西并没有实践上的用途。<br2/>但这并不意味着这些东西毫无意义。毫无疑问，像您这样的非凡存在，为自己创造一个舒适美丽的生活环境再自然不过了。

en_us.name: Decorations
en_us.description: Some things you may design and construct, indeed, serve no practical purpose.<br2/>That doesn't mean they are pointless, however. A mighty being like you, beyond any doubt, deserves to be surrounded by comfort and beauty if they choose to.

zh_cn.name: 附魔
zh_cn.description: 附魔，以其自身而言，乃是一种极佳的艺术形式。各个流派的大师都在寻求不同方法进行 附魔，并且，最终并没有人知道究竟哪种方法效果最好，甚至，是否有一种最好的方法存在，这件事也悬而未决。<br2/>与其他艺术一样，所有的附魔流派建基于同一基础之上，而你，无论如何，都需要认真钻研构成这一基础的各个要点。

en_us.name: Enchantments
en_us.description: Enchanting is a great form of art on itself. Different masters seek different approaches to executing it, and ultimately - there's no telling whichever approach is the most effective, and whether even there is one.<br2/>Just as in other arts, there are keystones that make up the foundation of any and all enchanting schools, ones you'll have to learn anyhow.

zh_cn.name: 资源和材料
zh_cn.description: 凡俗间的材料与资源丰富多样，你对其中的种种皆已烂熟于心。但，如果你继续深入探寻其中的道理，你便能发现更多的事物，这些事物甚至从未映入过你的眼帘<br2/>考虑到你还在不断探寻着新材料，并尝试锻造出更好地工具与盔甲，因而我会将部分新材料的特性标识出来，这应该对你来说颇有益处。

en_us.name: Resources & Materials
en_us.description: You are perfectly familiar with most mundane materials and resources, which this world holds plenty of. But should you dig a little further - and you might discover things even you have never beheld before.<br2/>As you keep seeking new materials to forge better tools and armor from, it would be worth to denote unusual properties of some of them.

zh_cn.name: 杂项
zh_cn.description: 有些知识分类起来极为困难。有时候，这些知识其实并不值得你花大力气去对付，丢一边得了。<br2/>然而，随意散漫地在桌面上放置些许纸张与卷轴堆，不循结构，亦无秩序，却仍有一种奇异的浪漫蕴藏在其中。这暗示了这样的一件事：在那以纯然混沌作为表象之处，往往能够孕育出伟大之事物。

en_us.name: Miscellaneous
en_us.description: Some knowledge proves to be extremely difficult to categorize. At times it ceases to be worth any effort at all.<br2/>There is some romance in leaving papers and scrolls stockpiled at the table, however, with no structure or order to them. Greatness is often born through what appears as sheer chaos.

zh_cn.name: 遗物
zh_cn.description: 无穷遗物散布在世界各地，而时代变迁，其中的许多早已被世人遗忘，而另一些则还流传于传说之中<br2/>而以探险与征服为生的你，恰好对这些东西极为地感兴趣，因为这些东西乃是通向不可思议之力量的钥匙，而且循其引导，在其背后，你似能找到你长久以来追寻的答案。

en_us.name: Artifacts
en_us.description: Countless relics are scattered across this world, many forgotten in ages, others - persisted in legends...<br2/>And as both explorer and conqueror, they just so happen to be your primary point of interest, as they are keys for reaching unimaginable power, and signs that may lead you to the answers you seek.

zh_cn.name: 工具和武器
zh_cn.description: 在无手头工具的情况下，哪怕是半神，也休想轻松地释放出自己体内那创生与毁灭之力。<br2/>剑实际上与其他工具并无二异——它同样有着自己的目的因，在沉默中遵循着自己的使命。只是，恰巧，它的目的是为了给敌人放血罢了。

en_us.name: Tools & Weapons
en_us.description: Even demigods often cannot easily unleash their creational and destructive powers, unless they have proper tool in their hands.<br2/>Swords are no different from any other tool - they are created to serve their purpose, and they silently obey their design. It just so happened that their purpose is to shed blood.

zh_cn.name: 世界
zh_cn.description: 有些人一旦找到宝藏，就只是不假思索地拿走自己想要的，而对其他的东西分文不取。这也不是说不对啥的，只是这样的行为与只会在夜中盲目寻求血液的怪物有何区别？有时，如果你观察再为细致一些，你就能发现，那遗迹以及逝去岁月留下的踪迹正在向你静静诉说着许多事情：那是一段悠久的历史，那是一段在你出发冒险之前的故事。

en_us.name: The World
en_us.description: Some choose to mindlessly scavenge whatever they come across for treasures, leaving behind anything else. That isn't an entirely unjustified path, but does it make one any better than those monsters blindly seeking blood in the night?... Sometimes, if you look just a bit closer, ruins and traces of the former ages can tell you a lot about long history before your advent.

除了书写材料和普通的空白卷轴之外，制作奥秘卷轴通常还会使用几种魔法原料，以确保您制作的卷轴所做的不只是存在而已。它们可以像其他任何附件一样随身携带。<br2/>它难于为你塑造古老书籍里提到的威武强大的法师形象。即使是精心设计，也可能无法带来实际有用的东西。
奇怪的是，即使是在最古老的文学中，也很难通过仅用于写作的卷轴来实现。<br2/>也许这不是一个显而易见的设计？
这里概述了制作空卷轴的方法。<br2/>本身作用不大，但是它可作为制作奥秘卷轴的基础。

Creation of arcane scrolls, besides writing materials and mundane blank scroll, will usually take a couple arcane ingredients, to make sure that the scroll you create does something more than just exist. They can be carried around like any other accessories.<br2/>These are unlikely contribute as much to your image of terrifying, mighty mage,

especially given that books were invented a long time ago by now. Yet that matters not given how vast are practical possibilities they may provide, if designed and put together masterfully.<br2/>Weirdly, it's difficult to come by a scroll used for just storing writings, even among the most ancient samples of literature.<br2/>Perhaps, it's not such an obvious design after all?..
Here is outlined the way to craft an empty scroll.<br2/>Might not be extremely useful on its own, but it serves as a base for creation of arcane scrolls.

这款优雅的卷轴是另一个遗物，利用七咒的无穷力量，满足隐藏在自己的灵魂深处的无尽贪婪。<br2/>它主要作用是使您交易或以物易物时扰乱对方的思维混乱，迷惑交易的真实价格和收益，这对您非常有利。
猪灵似乎最容易受到种能力的影响，因为他们无法抗拒金子的诱惑。
这卷轴不仅可以克服第二诅咒使他们对你中立，因为他们通常是针对那些一身黄金装备的人，而且还使得这些生物进行以物易物的平均收益约为原先的两倍，单次交易中获得的物品数量从正常到三倍不等。<br2/>村民也会受到这个卷轴的影响，即使不像猪灵一样多，也能从那小小的狂热人那里获得每笔交易固定35<percent/>的折扣。
不仅如此，当你杀死生物时，有轻微的概率将你贪婪梦境中的绿宝石转化为现实，并且 <&l>+1 时运等级<clear/> 将帮助您在矿井中获得更多的财富。
只要不让您的这种贪婪接管您的思想，您就会没事。

One another relic harnessing the boundless strength of the Seven Curses, this elegant scroll is designed to fulfill the boundless inner greed you so carefully conceal within your soul.
Its primary effect is an ability to confuse minds of the creatures you trade or barter with, into misguessing true price and benefit of the deal... much in your favor.

Piglins seem to be most affected by this ability, with their helpless affection by gold. Not only this allows the scroll to overcome the effect of the Second Curse and render them neutral in your regard, as they normally are

towards anyone who bears enough golden equipment on them, but it also makes bartering with those creatures about twice as beneficial on average, allowing you to get anywhere from normal item quantity to three times the quantity in exchange from any single barter.<br2/>Villagers are also affected by this scroll's ability, even though not as much as Piglins are - stable 35<percent/> discount on every trade is about as much

as you can get from their little avid person.<br2/>Apart from this, you also get a slight chance of having an entire Emerald materialize into existence right from within your avaricious dreams whenever you happen to slay any living creature, and <&l>+1 Fortune Level<clear/> which will doubtlessly help you get your hands on some more riches anytime you feel like descending into the mines.
Just don't let that greed of yours take over your mind, and you'll be fine.

畏惧死亡并不稀奇，毕竟它是一种生物本能。但是对于那些选择承受诅咒的人，恐惧是不可原谅的弱点。<br2/>借助“扭曲之心”的力量结合全部七个诅咒，你可以锻造这个勋章。它能将对你而言无比糟糕的局势逆转回来：
越是接近死亡之边缘，你的愤怒和勇气就会越发充实，在咽下最后一口气之前，无论情况有多么糟糕，你都得拼尽全力，为自己杀出一条血路。

It's no surprise how many fear death, for death lies in the center of web of all terrors. But for those who chose to bear the great curse, fear is unforgivable weakness.<br2/>With the power of Twisted Heart, as well as all seven curses combined, you can forge this emblem. It will help you flip the tables in your favor - the closer you'd stand to the
brim of imminent demise, the greater fury and courage will fulfill you, forcing to fight your way out no matter the circumstances, until the last breath.

大多数半神，甚至是那些离神船很近的人，都否认了这个卷轴的威力。由建筑师自己决定谁可以拥有这个卷轴，正如传言所说的那样——前往$（l：https://discord.gg/fuWK8ns)他领地$(/l)的路很长，而且充满危险，被这个虔诚的存在所关注是很罕有的荣誉。
然而，那些这样做的人被授予了无与伦比的权力；让世界沐浴在他们的荣耀中，让他们把信仰传播到别人的心中

The might of this rumor-shadowed scroll is denied to most demigods, even those who have approached the godship rather close. Who is permitted to possess it is at the discretion of The Architect himself, and as rumors would have it - the journey to $(l:https://discord.gg/fuWK8ns)his domain$(/l) is long and full of dangers, and to be noticed by that godly being is an honor few of its dwellers ever had.
Those who did, however, are awarded with power which has no equal; for the world to bask in their glory, and for them to spread the faith to the ears and eyes of others.

诅咒附魔与常规附魔大体类似，但在细节上有所差异：一旦将它们绑定到物品上，它们就与物品结合为共同体，一损俱损，若想剥除，只能是同归于尽。<br2/>好在，使用的常规附魔技术不会出现这种诅咒，但在探索古代遗迹和地牢时，你可能会遇到带有诅咒的物品。它们效果各异，但它们有一个共同点，即都不是纯然对你有利的：
任何带有诅咒的物品，在使用时都会有极为突出的缺点。在正常情况下，它们只是你避之不及的恼人之物。但是，既然你带上“七咒之戒”，你便可以通过多种方式来操纵它们，甚至是从中受益，而这是其他人不可能办到的。
这一卷轴内蕴含了来自于扭曲之心的浓郁邪恶之力，借助这一卷轴，从诅咒中借力不再是梦。你身着的每件装备上的每个诅咒附魔，都可以增加你的攻击伤害，挖掘速度以及任何形式的生命恢复力。如果只有一或两个诅咒附魔，那总体上的增益微乎其微，难以让人察觉；但你若是不惧怕诅咒缠身的情况，那卷轴则会赋予你令人惊异的力量。
能够影响卷轴效果的装备包括盔甲、两手上的物品以及任何可穿戴的东西，例如护身符或者戒指，甚至，如果你已将卷轴佩戴在身上，卷轴上的诅咒也会被计入。

At times curses can take form similar to that of enchantments, with a only couple differences. Unlike normal enchantments, once they are bound to item, there's seemingly no way to get rid of them while keeping the item itself. Hopefully, regular enchanting techniques which you use yourself cannot accidentally produce such curses - but you may come
across items bearing them when exploring ancient ruins and dungeons.<br2/>Their effects vary, but none are quite beneficial - any cursed enchantment presents significant drawback to using

the item that bears it. Under normal circumstances, they would be just an annoyance for you to avoid. However, now that you bear Ring of the Seven Curses, there are ways you can manipulate them and even benefit from them, inaccessible to others.<br2/>This scroll, being infused with concentrated wickedness of the Twisted Heart, presents one such possibility. For every curse that every item of your equipment bears, it boosts

your attack damage, mining speed and regenerative powers of any kind. The effect is sure negligible with only one or two curses, but if you are not afraid to take a little more, it can add up to enormous power.<br2/>The equipment that affects this scroll includes armor, items in both hands, and any wearables alike charms or rings, including even this same scroll itself when it is equipped.

你无法理解深渊之心那凌驾于现实之上的存在，但你最近发现，利用其能力并不需要理解其本质。在少数同样奇妙可怖、可从深渊之心汲取力量的物品中，这枚戒指现身了——它的不可名状之本质或许比七咒之戒更加可怕。
它让你免于无休止屠杀因七咒之戒而拒绝像从前那样容忍你存在的生物……它将这些生物从你身边抹除。
然而，扭曲现实是极度危险的。作为代价，一旦你决定戴上它，你将永远被它束缚。不久你将知道，比起最为可怕但永远存在的威胁，寂静的虚无更加让人难以忍受……

You can scarce comprehend presence imposed upon reality by Heart of the Abyss, but, as you have recently discovered, comprehension is not necessary for the ability to make use of it. Among few equally wonderful and terrible things that can draw power from it, there is this ring - even more nightmarish, perhaps, than Ring of the Seven Curses, in its
unnameable nature.<br2/>It offers to conveniently fulfill your gnawing desire to set yourself free of necessity to endlessly slaughter creatures that could once tolerate your presence,

but have lost such ability soon as you submitted yourself to the burden of Seven Curses... By erasing them from the very existence surrounding you.<br2/>The cost of such reality-bending power is perilous, however, as should you decide that you desire it - you will be bound to it forevermore. And as you know by now, void can be more unbearable than even most frightening, ever-present threat...

有很多种利用凋灵的力量的方法，这个宝珠就是其中之一，能够打破附魔台的极限。<br2/>首先，它使您可以避免想附魔时因为忘记了带一些青金石，而不得不跑两次到台子旁。<br2/>宝珠从“七咒之戒”内部汲取了力量，将其用作附魔过程的催化剂，替代了青金石。
因此，附魔任何物品时获得的附魔数量和力量比普通附魔要高得多。还可以实现以前认为不可能的事情：在附魔台中附魔装备产生独特的宝藏附魔，例如经验修补。
缺点是还有机会获得一些诅咒附魔，但通常不会得到，因此后者的能力有点像一把双刃剑。

Among many ways you can harness the power of Wither's soul, there is this truly precious pearl, capable of breaking the limits you usually have to cope with when working with Enchanting Table.<br2/>First, it allows you to once and for all forget about having to run to the table twice anytime you want to enchant something, only

because you forgot to bring some Lapis with you the first time. Instead of using Lapis Lazuli, the pearl draws power from within the Ring of the Seven Curses to use it as catalyzer for enchanting process. As a result, the

amount and power of enchantments you will be getting when enchanting anything are significantly higher on average than with normal enchanting.<br2/>This process also allows to achieve what was thought to be impossible before - produce unique treasure enchantments on your gear, such as Mending, right within that Enchanting Table of yours. Unfortunately, there also is a chance you will get some curses instead,
which you normally wouldn't have gotten, so this latter ability is somewhat of a double-edged sword.

末影箱是非常实用的东西，它使您可以在任意距离和维度内访问自己的私人物品。与你随身携带的物品不同，当末影箱的物理外壳被破坏时，位于箱内的物品不会受到威胁。<br2/>缺点是，你需要随身携带那个巨大的箱子，当您想从其超维空间中拿东西时，需要将其放置，之后再用精致工具将其拆除，除非您愿意将其粉碎成
黑曜石碎片，然后再仔细地将其融合在一起。<br2/>末影之戒正是为解决这个问题而设计的，它使您能够撕裂空间结构，仅用意志力就可以接触到您的末影箱中的物品。
只是当您松开裂痕时，别忘了拉出您的手。

Ender Chest has proven to be extremely useful thing, allowing you to access items of your choice across any distances and dimensions. Unlike items you may carry on yourself, those in your ender chest are not endangered when your physical shell gets destroyed.<br2/>There is a slight inconvenience to it, however -

the need to carry around that massive chest, chucking it down whenever you want to pull something out of its extradimensional depths, and then removing it with incredibly delicate tool, unless you want it to be

shattered into obsidian pieces you once so carefully fused together.<br2/>Ring of Ender is designed exactly to solve this issue, allowing you to tear the fabric of space and access contents of your ender chest with nothing but sheer force of will.<br2/>Just don't forget to pull your hand out of when you release the rift.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.enigmatic_elytra.page.1
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.enigmatic_elytra.page.2
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.enigmatic_elytra.page.3
只需一些烟花火箭，鞘翅就成为了一种出色的交通工具。它可以轻易超越任何马、船以及矿车。但想要长时间使用它需要解决两个关键问题：快速损耗的耐久，以及稳定的烟花火箭供应。
壮丽鞘翅解决了这两个问题。它具有极高的耐久，并且在飞行的过程中，佩戴者可以随时根据自己的想法使用末影与星辰之力推动自己前进，其效果与烟花火箭无异。
这样做会加速其耐久消耗，但可在铁砧上用以太锭修复——这应该不会是太大的问题。<br2/>除此之外，它还有许多鲜艳的色彩图案，使得没有人会怀疑其非凡的品质。

Combined with some fireworks, Elytra provides an outstanding means of transportation, easily outpacing any horse, boat or minecart alike. There are only two major concerns surrounding its prolonged use - swift weardown, and necessity to maintain steady supply of fireworks.<br2/>Majestic Elytra resolves both of them. It offers remarkable

durability, and can use enderic energies to propel the wearer forward during the flight at their wish, in a manner not dissimilar to fireworks. Doing so puts greater strain on hardness of the elytra, but insofar it can

be repaired with etherium in conventional anvil - that should not be too much of a concern.<br2/>Apart from that, it is covered with much more vibrant color patterns, leaving nobody in doubt regarding its magnificent, extraordinary qualities.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.escape_scroll.page.1
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.escape_scroll.page.2
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.escape_scroll.page.3
尽管事实证明，死亡只是像您这种半神的小麻烦，但有时这种麻烦会造成巨大的损失。<br2/>根据死亡的地方，损失可能远高你的付出，由最好的材料锻造的装备，从世界各地收集到的东西，都有可能消失或者难以恢复。<br2/>此卷轴是对这种情况的保证。
它无法保护你免于死亡，但如果你倒下了，它会将你掉落的任何东西带回你的重生点，即便是跨越维度。
卷轴自身仍将保留在你被杀死的地方，不同于普通的掉落物，它不会燃烧，也不会落入导致你灭亡的虚空，也不会因为无人看管而消失。<br2/>只有半神的手，尽管不一定是你的手，才能将其收回。

Though death has proven to be only a temporary inconvenience for a demigod like you, sometimes this inconvenience takes great toll.
Much greater than you would like to pay - depending on where you die, your precious gear, forged from finest materials and collected from all corners of the Overworld, can be lost to Oblivion or incredibly difficult to recover.

This scroll is an insurance against such happening.<br2/>It cannot protect its bearer from death, but should their life be taken, whatever they would drop in place of their death will instead be taken

back to the respawn point, across any distances and dimensions. The scroll itself will remain where its bearer was killed, but unlike items you would normally drop, it will not burn, or fall into the Void where you might've met your demise, or vanish into nothingness if you leave it unattended for too long.<br2/>Only the hand of demigod, though not necessarily yours alone, can ever claim it back.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.fabulous_scroll.page.1
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.fabulous_scroll.page.2
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.fabulous_scroll.page.3
最终，您的期望得到了证实。通往末地的大门以开启，无限的范围配上优越的力量，您将制作出天堂之礼的改进版本。<br2/>可能无法完全消除其前代的限制，但至少会大大扩展它们的限制范围。
此卷轴确实允许您在各个世界维度上自由飞行，而无需保持靠近信标。但是，仅凭经验为飞行提供动力非常昂贵，所以不要指望能像靠近信标那样的持续。
另一方面，造物主的恩赐能够更有效地消耗信标的力量，如果您停留在该范围内，则无需消耗任何经验就可以保持所有能力。

Your expectations were, eventually, confirmed. Now that the gate to The End is open and its boundless reaches have fell before your superior might, you were finally able to design an improved version of Gift of the Heaven.<br2/>One that may not eliminate limits of its precursor entirely, but at least expands them significantly.

This scroll does allow you to freely fly across the skies of all worlds and dimension, without need to stay close the Beacon. Powering your flight with experience alone is quite expensive though, so don't expect your ascension to last

nearly as long as it would within the beacon's range.<br2/>On the other hand, Grace of the Creator is capable of draining beacon's power much more efficiently, and should you choose to stay within that range, you will not have to sacrifice any experience at all to remain above all others.

book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.golden_ring.page.2
需要更多工艺和更多的珍贵黄金，您可以将平凡的戒指重新锻造为更加光彩和更奇特的形式。<br2/>该配件的唯一显着特性，除了闪闪发亮和金色外，它对猪灵的作用就像穿金护甲一样，当看到你手指上的戒指时，他们会更加尊重您，进入他们的视野就不会试图杀死你。

A bit more work and about as much of precious gold, and you can reforge mundane iron ring into much shinier and fancier form.<br2/>The only notable property of this accessory, apart from being all shiny and golden, is that it has effect on Piglins similar to wearing gold armor - they will respect you a bit more when seeing this
preciousness on your finger, and won't try to kill as soon as you enter their field of view.

book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.heaven_scroll.page.2
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.heaven_scroll.page.3
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.heaven_scroll.page.4
就像其他半神和人类曾经做过的那样，自从旅途开始以来，你就梦想着超越脆弱的身体极限。除了常规能力外，还梦想自由漫游这个世界的天空，就像一个凌驾于所有其他事物之上的神。<br2/>好吧，此卷轴可不允许您漫游所有天空。但是，凭借下界之星的强大力量，它可以做一些事情。
当你激活一个信标时，他会出现一条直透天空的光束，在信标的信标的奥术光环内，你会获得易用的悬浮飞行技能。
可惜，这种光环力量还不够强大，无法持续消耗大量能量来维持你的飞行能力。卷轴会缓慢吸收消耗你的经验，以保持你在空中。<br2/>您非常肯定有一种方法来提高其能量并克服它的局限性，但是在很长一段时间内，你只能用着这个。

As any other demigod or human once did, ever since the beginning of your journey you dreamed to transcend the limits of your vulnerable body. That dream, among all other attributes, included freely roaming the skies of this world, alike a god above all other.<br2/>Well, this scroll might not allow you to roam all the
skies. But with the immense might of the Nether Star powering it, it can do a thing or two.<br2/>Should you find yourself in the presence of an active Beacon, penetrating skies with

its vivid lightbeam - and Gift of the Heaven will grant you highly controllable and convenient ability to float and fly around, as long as you don't wonder to far away from beacon's arcane aura.<br2/>That aura, unfortunately, isn't strong enough on its own to continuously drain much required energy for powering your flight from it. The scroll will slowly, yet steadily consume experience you absorbed, to be able to keep
you in the air.<br2/>You are pretty sure there must be a way to improve its power and overcome the limitations it has, but for a while longer that's what you are left to work with.

book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.insignia.page.2
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.insignia.page.3
乍一看，这个小饰品似乎毫无用处，它不会增加你的力量、速度或意志。但它决不仅限于此。它允许你在其他半神眼中隐藏你的名字，并用你喜欢的昵称代替它。更方便的是，它并不会减少你能够装备的饰品数量。
最明显的使用方法是欺骗其他半神，但其潜能有限，它只会影响别人所见的你的名字。此外，拥有或与某些神力有联系的人仍然能够认出你的真名。
。<br2/>它的另外一种用法是让自己与众不同。创造力是无限的，尤其是当你拥有设计师的墨水时。设计师的墨水能够产生的花哨颜色与格式完全能够用与于迷人徽章来改变你的名字。

Although this little trinket will not afford you increased strength, speed or will - there is more to it than appears at first glance. It allows you to conceal your name in the eyes of other demigods, and replace it with the one of your liking. Conveniently, it does not reduce the amount of other charms you can bear beside it.<br2/>The obvious way to make use

of it would be deception, but potential here is unfortunately limited, as insignia will only affect the name others see when they observe you in person. Besides, those who possess or are connected with certain godlike powers may

still be able to recognize your true name.<br2/>Another way is to distinguish yourself. This is where opportunities are limitless, especially considering that fancy colors and styles The Architect's Inkwell is known to be capable of producing are fully applicable to the alternative name you can engrave upon your insignia.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.iron_ring.page.1
这件小东西的设计极为简单，哪怕是最最蹩脚的工匠都能打造出来，更别提像您这样的半神了。<br2/>戒指的作用不多，因为锻造它的素材仅是一些凡铁。它或许没办法帮你逃脱被斩首的厄运，但也许某天，它能护住你的手指不被切断……或许吧。

Quite simple in its design, this thing could've been forged even by the most casual blacksmith, not to mention a demigod alike you.<br2/>This ring is only useful as all it takes to create is some mundane iron. It might not save you from being beheaded, but can protect one of your fingers from being cut off someday... Perhaps.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.magnet_ring.page.1
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.magnet_ring.page.2
尽管设计简单，但是磁力之戒已经拥有了一些奥术力量。<br2/>也许不是一个无法抗拒的东西，但仍然很有用，无论您周围的地面上有什么东西，这枚戒指都会将它带到您身边，为您省去走动和拾取的工作。
它的一个显着特性是，您试图扔掉的物品会拒绝离开您，立即尝试重新收入背包，除非您自愿抑制戒指的力量。

Despite simplicity of its design, Magnetic Ring already holds some arcane power.<br2/>Perhaps not the one that defies creation itself, yet still quite useful - whatever thing might be lying on the ground around you, this ring will bring it towards you, sparing you the labor of walking to it and picking it  up yourself.
One of its notable properties is that items you might attempt to throw away will refuse to leave you, instantly attempting to re-enter your inventory, unless you willingly suppress the ring's power.

pages.title: meh
pages.text: 世界上大多数有价值的金属和矿物都隐藏在地下深处。因此，您经常需要在潮湿，寒冷和黑暗的地下环境中花费无数的时间，挖着漫长的隧道以寻找所需的资源。<br2/>这个饰品可不会使您免于经历它，但至少它可以减少一些黑暗和无聊的时光。
它赋予了使任何矿工都嫉妒的能力，使您能够以更快的速度破坏障碍物，在黑暗中像在日光下一样清晰可见，并有着很远的接触距离。
它也可能会稍微提高你获得宝藏的机会可能吧，毕竟那只是谣言。

pages.title: meh
pages.text: Most of this world's valuable metals and minerals are hidden deep below its surface. Because of that, you often find yourself in need to spend countless hours in damp, cold and dark underground, digging seemingly endless tunnels in search of resources you require.<br2/>This charm may not spare you the burden of having to go

through it, but at least it can make those hours slightly less dark and boringly long. It grants powers that would make any miner jealous, allowing you to tear blocks apart significantly faster than you could otherwise, see in dark

as clearly as in daylight, and be able to reach things with your pickaxe from much further away.<br2/>It might also shift the odds just a bit in your favor in your search of treasures... probably. Maybe that part was only rumors, after all.

pages.title: meh
pages.text: 有时，那些在黑暗中无脑地徘徊的怪物会变得非常烦人。现在你有能量锻造下界合金了，这种合金做成的刀片即使是经常切硬物也只是轻微损耗。<br2/>但有时候仍然需要多次打击才能分离它们的肉体和灵魂，效果并不理想。怪物猎人勋章是完美的饰品，帮助你在这些频繁的遭遇中为您省下一两次出刀。
生物被杀死时能掉落更多战利品。如果这些生物恰好是怪物，您还可以通过经验的形式吸收它们更多的生命力。
你应该听说过一些英雄故事，这些英雄曾一生致力于与怪物战斗，但最终自己变成了怪物。<br2/>但是，看看常见的僵尸，您就可以确定自己永远不会遭受这种命运。你和它之间怎么可能有共同点？

pages.title: meh
pages.text: Sometimes those monsters mindlessly wandering in the dark can become great annoyance. Now that you hold power to forge Netherite, more often than not they're reduced from once considerable threat to a slight inconvenience staining your blade. However, at times it still takes a couple strikes to make sure their souls ceased to cling to flesh, and doing so isn't
incredibly rewarding on its own anymore.<br2/>Emblem of Monster Slayer is a perfect charm to aid you in these frequent encounters, saving you a hit or two of your sword.

Creatures slain when bearing it will leave behind more useful stuff you can collect. Should those creatures happen to be monsters, you will also be able to absorb greater part of their life force, in form of experience.<br2/>A couple times you've happened across stories of heroes, who have dedicated their life for once to fighting monsters, yet ended up becoming monsters on their own. Just by looking at the common zombie, however,
you are pretty sure you shall never have to suffer such fate. How could you possibly have anything in common?..

book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.super_magnet_ring.page.2
期待已久的磁力之戒升级版，错位之戒在各个方面都比它好。<br2/>注入了一些来自末地的神秘力量后，它的作用范围变为其前身的两倍，并且它的原理不再是不是将物品吸引到你身上，而是……将你吸引到物品上。受影响的物品的行为就像您正站在它们旁边一样。
这枚戒指还继承了它前身的特性，除非抑制它的力量，否则它不会让你扔掉物品。

A long anticipated upgrade of Magnetic Ring, the Ring of Dislocation is better in every way.<br2/>Infused with fraction of mystical energy of The End, it covers area twice as large as its predecessor, and instead of drawing dropped items towards you, it... draws you towards items. In every regard, affected items will behave as

if you were standing right next to them, effectively existing in multiple places at once. This ring also inherits property of its parent, not letting your own items drop unless you completely suppress its power.

这种被称为经验的空灵物质处理起来麻烦又困难。尽管您自身具有无限量吸收的能力，但是您不具备有效地分配它的能力。<br2/>当你吸收和保留得越多，执行附魔之类的操作消耗就越多，有时造成严重的浪费。更令人烦恼的是，一旦您的身体被撕裂，大部分经验都会消失，只留下了一小部分。
但如果您将手放在这幅宏伟的卷轴上，这种挫败感将消散。它可以快速吸收并其保存您的经验，直到您想要将其索回。
永恒智慧卷轴可以精确控制来回转移的数量，因此，您可以根据需求有效的管理自己的宝贵经验，因为存储在卷轴中的经验不会计入您自己的总数。<br2/>只需查看一眼，您就可以方便地估算出一段时间内产生了多少经验。<br2/>当携带它并激活时，此卷轴还可以吸收掉落在您周围较大区域内的任何经验球。

The ethereal substance known as experience often is quite difficult and inconvenient to handle. Though yourself you possess ability to absorb any amount of it, what you do not possess is a possibility to effectively distribute it afterwards.<br2/>The more you absorb and withhold at once, the greater amount arts like enchanting

consume to be performed, at times getting unimaginably wasteful. Even more irritating, once your physical shell gets torn apart, most of your experience simply vanishes, leaving only insignificant morsels left behind.

Should you lay your hands on this magnificent scroll, however, and that frustration will finally come to an end.<br2/>It can quickly and easily absorb your experience, withholding it until you choose to claim it back. Scroll of Ageless Wisdom allows to precisely control how much is transferred back and forth, thus enabling you to manage your precious experience as effectively as you wish, as experience stored in scroll

does not count towards your own total. Just by looking at it, you can conveniently estimate how much experience it stores at any given time.<br2/>While it is active and carried among your other accessories, this scroll also absorbs any experience clumps that might be dropped in large area around you.

你很一定可以轻松猜到，以太的力量能打造终极护甲。以太护甲也许并不是真正的终极装备，但到目前为止，它已经超越了你可以创造或已经拥有的一切护甲。<br2/>它的第一个显着特性是，当你装备上，护甲将变得不可见，并且与普通金属锻造的盔甲相比，携带的负担要少得多。

pages.heading: 盔甲套装
pages.text: 直到某些东西试图与你或该护甲互动之前，你可能完全遗忘你依旧装备它的事实，对于装备它的人来说，它的重量是那么的不明显。
但是，这种轻松并不意味着在提供防御方面会变差。它具有极高的防御力，甚至可以取代下界合金护甲。不仅如此，它还具有超乎想象的耐久，即使是剧烈打击之后也几乎不会在其表面留下划痕。<br2/>不仅如此，每个护甲似乎会彼此产生共鸣，促使释放这种材质的内在能量。
如果你同时穿戴所有四件护甲，共鸣将会达到巅峰，它将能用能量酝成强大的护盾，保护其你免受大部分弹射物的伤害，显著削弱敌人的攻击，并试图击退他们。<br2/>但是，这种护盾需要大量能量来维持。
尽管护甲具有出色的保护能力，但只有在你受到重伤时，它才会激活护盾。当你健康并因此能够在无其他保护措施下应对即将到来的威胁时，护盾便会关闭，以太护甲会缓慢补充其内在能量，直到再次需要时。
当你的生命值低于一半时，你会注意到你的护盾和凋灵的护盾非常相似。这意味着以太力量的起源和性质有某种联系，但是你似乎还没有足够的线索将他们联系在一起。<br2/>以下页面描述了如何锻造以太护甲。

Surely, it didn't take you too long to guess that newfound power of etherium might come in handy in an attempt of forging the ultimate armor. Etherium armor might not be truly ultimate, yet by far it surpasses anything you can create or lay claim upon.<br2/>One of its first notable properties is that should you equip it and bear on your

pages.heading: The Armor Set
pages.text: body, the armor itself becomes completely invisible and feels much less of a burden to carry than armor forged from mundane metals. Until something attempts to interact with you or that armor, it's actually possible to entirely forget you even carry it, that's how unnoticeable is its weight for one who bears it.

That ease, however, doesn't mean it's worse at absorbing enemy attacks. It supersedes even netherite armor it how extremely hard it is to penetrate. More than that, it also is unimaginably durable - even the most crushing blows barely leave a scratch on its surface.<br2/>And as if that wasn't enough, individual armor pieces seem to resonate with one another, urging to unleash the metal's inner energy.

Should you carry all four pieces simultaneously, and that resonation achieves its peak, finally being able to manifest itself into powerful shield woven out of sheer energy, protecting its bearer from most projectiles, significantly weakening attacks that it isn't capable of blocking completely, and knocking back whoever attempts to execute these attacks.<br2/>That shield, however, takes a lot of energy to sustain.

It only activates when its bearer somehow manages to get severely wounded, despite outstanding protection of the armor itself. When they remain at their full health and thus can manage to deal with incoming threats without additional measures of protection, the shield is dispelled and etherium slowly replenishes its inner energy, until the need to manifest it arises again.<br2/>It's difficult to not notice the

similarity of that shield to one Wither conjures when brought down to half of its health. That must imply some relation to origin and nature of etherium's power, but you don't seem to have enough clues to put pieces of this story together just yet.<br2/>Following pages contain depictions of how etherium armor can be forged, according to your design.

星尘可以派上的用场之一是药水酿造。它的非凡特性可以实现以前被认为不可能的效果，创造出兼具强化和延长效果的终极药水。<br2/>以下页面包含了可以实现的效果的示例。

pages.heading: 终极药水酿造
pages.text: 终极药水可以从扩展药水中酿造，如果选择的药水有这种变化的话。<br2/>效果大同小异。

pages.heading: 终极力量
pages.text: 如果药水拥有延长和强化版本，终极药水将会结合两者的优点。比如力量药水，它的终极药水将拥有力量II 8分钟。

pages.heading: 终极隐身
pages.text: 如果药水只有延长版本，那么终极药水的持续时间将会是延长版本的两倍。好比这个，终极隐身药水将持续16分钟。

pages.heading: 终极治疗
pages.text: 如果药水具有即时效果，那么它只会提升一个效果等级。终极治疗药水将会拥有瞬间治疗III

pages.heading: 终极喷溅型剧毒
pages.text: 它们也可以通过常规方式制作飞溅和滞留型版本。

One of immediate ways Astral Dust may come in handy is in potion brewing. Its unusual properties allow to achieve what was previously thought of as impossible, creating ultimate potions that combine both powerful effect and extended duration.<br2/>Following pages contain examples of effects you may achieve by doing so.

pages.heading: Ultimate Potion Brewing
pages.text: Ultimate potions can be brewed from both extended and, if chosen potion has such variation, empowered version.<br2/>Result will not vary from this.

pages.heading: Ultimate Strength
pages.text: If potion has both extended and empowered version, its ultimate version will combine best from both. In case with Strength, this means that its ultimate potion will apply Strength II for 8 minutes.

pages.heading: Ultimate Invisibility
pages.text: If a potion has only extended version, typically it will have doubled duration of extended version. As seen here, ultimate Invisibility potion applies its effect for 16 minutes.

pages.heading: Ultimate Healing
pages.text: If a potion has instant effect, it will just receive one additional level of effect. Thus Potion of Healing will apply Instant Health III if brewed into ultimate version.

pages.heading: Ultimate Splash Poison
pages.text: They can also be brewed from and converted into both splash and lingering versions, via conventional means.

一种鲜为人知的药水。但他的实际效果是非常有用的，它对于长时间进行采矿的人最为有用，因为它能以更快的速度击碎岩石和泥土。除此之外，在战斗中它也非常有用，它可以让你的连击间隔更短。

pages.heading: 酿造
pages.text: 酿造它不困难，只需将下界石英混合到粗制的药水中就可以了。

pages.heading: 延长效果
pages.text: 混合一些红石粉可以延长其效果，也可以……

pages.heading: 强化效果
pages.text: ……混合荧石粉增强其效果

pages.heading: 喷溅型版本
pages.text: 或者酿造喷溅型形态……

pages.heading: 滞留型版本
pages.text: ……或滞留型类型，就像其他任何普通药水一样。

A type of potion that isn't as widely known as usable as common set.<br2/>Practical applications it can have are fairly obvious. It is mostly useful for long mining sessions, as it allows to tear through rocks and dirt at much faster rate. Besides that, however, it might prove to also be somewhat usable in combat, as it also makes your attacks

pages.heading: Brewing the Potion
pages.text: slightly faster and easier to chain up in short time.<br2/>Brewing it isn't any difficult - just fuse nether quartz into awkward potion, and that's it.

pages.heading: Extending Duration
pages.text: Its effect can either gain extended length, by fusing some redstone dust...

pages.heading: Strengthening Effect
pages.text: ...or increased power with the use of glowstone.

pages.heading: Splash Version
pages.text: You can also brew it into splash...

pages.heading: Lingering Version
pages.text: ...or lingering types, just like you can any other regular potion.

pages.heading: 酿造
pages.text: 最终，你会在下界蒸腾的熔岩海中有更加愉快的体验。

pages.heading: 延长效果

pages.heading: 滞留型版本

This one serves as an improved version of Fire Resistance potion, should you find yourself willing to invest less common ingredients in order to obtain greater effect.<br2/>Besides granting you complete immunity to fire and lava, it extinguishes you when you are on fire, and improves your sense of surroundings in molten magmatic currents to noticeable extent.

pages.heading: Brewing the Potion
pages.text: Ultimately, it should make the experience of stewing in lava oceans of the Nether considerably more enjoyable.

pages.heading: Extending Duration
pages.text: Its effect can be extended using redstone dust.

pages.heading: Splash Version
pages.text: You can also brew it into splash...

pages.heading: Lingering Version
pages.text: ...or lingering types, just like you can any other regular potion.

游历未知的地域总是令人兴奋和惊喜。从这些地域返回家乡，通常会走曾经走过的路线，偶尔抄一下近路。<br2/>但是手头有该药水可以帮助您跳过无聊的回程，饮用它后会立即传送你回家。或者，至少在技术上叫家的地方。

pages.heading: 药水酿造
pages.text: 如果你没有，那么您将传送到这个世界的旅程初始的地方。尽管您不知道确切的位置在哪里，只知道它在那个地方附近。
无论您距离目的地多远，即使不在相同的维度上，药水都会生效。

Journeying into the unknown lands is always somewhat interesting and exciting. Journeying back home from those lands, covering the route you once already taken - usually not nearly as much.<br2/>But having this potion at a hand can help you skip that boring part of covering all the distance on the way back, as it instantly teleports you

pages.heading: The Potion Brewing
pages.text: back home when you drink it. Or, well, at least to a place you can technically call home.<br2/>If you don't have one, you will instead end up somewhere around the place where your

journey across this world's lands has first started. Though you cannot be sure where exactly you will end up, apart from knowing it's somewhere close to that place.<br2/>The potion takes effect regardless of the distance that separates you and your destination, and regardless of whether you even are in the same dimension.

扭曲之心的力量使召回药水的本质发生了变化，让它具有了全新的作用。<br2/>就像你称呼它为扭曲恩惠药水一样，它会把你传送到你上次死亡的地点，让你有机会重新收集遗留在此处的物品以及灵魂水晶。

pages.heading: 救赎？
pages.text: 然而，你需要小心谨慎，因为上述机会是有代价的——一旦传送完成，你会发现你的身体几乎重返接近死亡边缘的时刻。
不久之后，上次杀死你的生物又会再一次抓住你。

With the power of the Twisted Heart you can now mutate the essence of Potion of Recall, providing it with a new purpose.<br2/>Potion of Twisted Mercy, as you call it, will permit you to warp back to wherever exactly your last death occurred, and hopefully recollect your possessions along with a part of your soul you have

pages.heading: The Potion Brewing
pages.text: probably left there. Beware, however, for such opportunity comes at a cost - as soon as teleportation is complete you will find yourself almost dead again, and it may not be long before whatever killed you
last time gets you once more.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.lamp.page.1
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.lamp.page.2
荧石是一种可靠的光源，但是放置大量的原始荧石并不能创造出很好的美感。取而代之的是，你想到了与普通灯笼类似的设计，而且它更大，更亮。<br2/>就像灯笼那样，它可以放在地上，也可以挂在天花板。
通过多次实验，你还创造了更漂亮的设计，将灯笼封装在一个玻璃里。<br2/>这样一来，便无需将其支撑在地板上和吊在天花板上。

Glowstone is a good and reliable source of light, but chucking down chunks of raw glowstone doesn't really create much aesthetics. Instead of doing that, you came up with the design similar to that of a common lantern, albeit larger and brighter.<br2/>Just like lanterns, you can place lamps on the floor, or hang them from ceiling.

Through extensive experimentation you also created somewhat more sophisticated design, with the lamp being encased within a block of glass.<br2/>That removes the need for it to be supported by floor or have something above it could be attach to.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.redstone_lantern.page.1
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.redstone_lantern.page.2
红石灯笼是大灯笼的的另一种设计，用红石灯代替原来的荧石制作。<br2/>不同于红石灯本身，红石灯笼在其结构中嵌入了能量源，所以他会保存亮灯。即使如此，它也不受外界红石信号影响，给他通入红石信号并不会使他熄灭。
在其他方面，它们与对应的荧石灯笼完全一致，只是它们的外观略有不同。

Redstone lanterns are another variation to lamp design, manufactured from redstone lamps instead of raw glowstone.<br2/>Unlike redstone lamps themselves, redstone lanterns embed source of power within their structure, so that they remain turned on. That source is encased in such way, however, that it cannot be directly influenced by outer

redstone signals, thus not allowing those lanterns to be turned off.<br2/>In every other regard, they are completely similar to their glowstone counterparts, with only their core having slightly different appearance.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.shroomlamp.page.1
在下界里那些充满植物生命的地方，菌光体是漂亮的天然光源。但是你可以稍微改进一下它，以用于作制作大灯笼的替代材料。<br2/>以菌光体为核心的灯笼与荧石灯笼功能上完全相同，尽管其外观不同。

Shroomlights are beautiful natural source of lightning in those common spaces of nether that brim with plantlife. But you can adapt that source to serve as alternative material for manufacturing lamps.<br2/>Lamps created with shroomlight as their core are completely identical to their glowstone counterparts, albeit different look of their core.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.ceaseless_enchantment.page.1

pages.title: book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.ceaseless_enchantment.heading.1
pages.text: book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.ceaseless_enchantment.page.2
可以附在弩上的附魔，简单易用。<br2/>效果与弓的无限附魔基本相同。当附魔在弩上时，射击时不会消耗常规箭矢，这样你就不必担心要补充箭矢了。<br2/>

pages.title: 附魔
pages.text: 只会在常规箭矢上起效，药水箭和烟火不受无尽附魔影响，他们仍会正常消耗。

Another possible crossbow enchantment, fairly useful in its simplicity.<br2/>Its effects are basically identical to that of Infinity enchantment on bows. With this enchantment on your crossbow, regular arrows from your inventory will not be consumed when shooting them, so that you won't have to worry about restocking your supply.<br2/>

pages.title: The Enchantment
pages.text: It does only work on regular arrows, however - tipped arrows or fireworks are not affected by Ceaseless enchantment, and will be used up as normal.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.eternal_binding_curse.page.1

pages.title: book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.eternal_binding_curse.heading.1
pages.text: book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.eternal_binding_curse.page.2
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.eternal_binding_curse.page.3
这个诅咒附魔的名称与“绑定诅咒”如此相似并非偶然——因为它与后者作用几乎完全相同，防止你移除已装备的盔甲和配饰。然而，不同之处在于带有此诅咒附魔的物品在你死亡后也不会与你分离。

pages.title: 诅咒附魔
pages.text: 对于盔甲而言，这并不严重，因为它迟早会因为耐久耗尽而损坏；然而对于大多数配饰而言，这个诅咒附魔会使你永远无法脱下配饰，直到你永久死亡或到达时间的尽头。
不像其绝大多数其他附魔，获得此诅咒附魔的唯一方法似乎是装备附魔师的珍珠后在附魔台附魔时得到。

The similarity of this curse's name to Curse of Binding is no accident - for it does exactly the same thing as the latter, preventing you from removing armor and accessories from yourself once equipped. The twist, however, is in the fact that items bearing this one will persist with you even across death. This might be less severe in the case of armor, since sooner or later

pages.title: The Curse
pages.text: it will break; for most accessories, however, with this curse applied you condemn yourself to bear them until you die permanently or until the end of time, whichever comes first.<br2/>Unlike most other curses, the only way to obtain this one seems to be by using classical
Enchanting Table, empowered by the Enchanter's Pearl.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.nemesis_curse.page.1

pages.title: book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.nemesis_curse.heading.1
pages.text: book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.nemesis_curse.page.2
一种鲜为人知的诅咒型附魔，相比其他诅咒更奇异和难明。<br2/>它仅能附着在近战武器上，像剑或斧。如果你使用带有复仇诅咒的武器进行攻击，自身将受到造成的伤害的 25% 伤害。<br2/>

pages.title: 复仇
pages.text: 但是，无论你造成多大攻击，此诅咒都永远不会杀死你。<br2/>它会保留你小量生命值，使你变得不堪一击。

One of the less known cursed enchantments, this one is more curious and obscure than others.<br2/>It can only be encountered on melee weapons, alike swords or axes. Should you directly attack with the weapon that bears Curses of Nemesis, you will receive around 25 percents of the damage you dealt back upon yourself.<br2/>

pages.title: The Curse
pages.text: However, no matter how devastating your blows will be, this curse can never kill you.<br2/>It will eventually leave you with just a sliver of health remaining, but something else will have to take this sliver for you to finally die.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.sharpshooter_enchantment.page.1

pages.title: book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.sharpshooter_enchantment.heading.1
pages.text: book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.sharpshooter_enchantment.page.2
可以附在弩上的附魔，极为有用。<br2/>可以增加弩箭的伤害，效果与弓的力量附魔基本相同。具体而言，神射手的每一等级都会使弩的伤害在基础上增加 <&l>40%%$(clear)

pages.title: 附魔
pages.text: 神射手只会影响箭矢，例如，它不会增加烟火的伤害。<br2/>此外，它与多重射击和穿透附魔冲突。

One of possible crossbow enchantments, this one stands among the most useful.<br2/>It increases the damage that arrows shot with the crossbow deal, somewhat similar to Power on bows. More precisely, for each level of Sharpshooter applied base damage of the crossbow will be increased by <&l>+40%%$(clear).

pages.title: The Enchantment
pages.text: Sharpshooter only affects arrows - it will not increase damage of fireworks, for instance. Furthermore, it cannot be combined with Multishot or Piercing.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.slayer_enchantment.page.1

pages.title: book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.slayer_enchantment.heading.1
pages.text: book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.slayer_enchantment.page.2
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.slayer_enchantment.page.3
另一种可以为你的剑和斧头增加伤害的附魔，他与锋利、亡灵杀手和节肢杀手属于同类别附魔，因此与它们互斥。<br2/>它会为你的武器增加对所有怪物的伤害。每级魔咒增加 1.5 伤害，

pages.title: 附魔
pages.text: 比起亡灵杀手 +2.5 的伤害要少。但是他依然是非常可靠的选择，因为它的效果句湖覆盖了全部的敌对怪物，而亡灵杀手和节肢杀手仅涵盖了其中的一部分。
此外，被带有这个魔咒的武器攻击的怪物会被短暂减速。

Another enchantment that allows you to increase damage of your sword or axe, it resides in same category as Sharpness, Smite or Bane of Arthropods, therefore being mutually exclusive with all of those.<br2/>It increases any damage your weapon deals against anything classified as monster. The exact damage increase is +1.5,

pages.title: The Enchantment
pages.text: multiplied by the level of enchantment itself, which is noticeably less than +2.5 increase you will get from Smite against undead for instance. However, it is still a very solid choice among its counterparts, since monsters do conveniently include almost anything that you have to fight back against, while undead
are much less all-encompassing category, not to mention arthropods covered by Bane of Arthropods.<br2/>Additionally, monsters attacked by a weapon with this enchantment are briefly slowed down.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.sorrow_curse.page.1

pages.title: book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.sorrow_curse.heading.1
pages.text: book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.sorrow_curse.page.2
此诅咒附魔仅适用于盔甲。你受到敌人攻击后，会承受严重的后果。你受到的每一击都会使你获得负面效果——伤害越高，负面效果越强。<br2/>幸运的是，每件拥有此诅咒附魔的盔甲在你受到攻击时仅有十分之一的几率触发上述效果。

pages.title: 诅咒附魔
pages.text: 同往常一样，你能偶尔在远古宝藏中找到带有此诅咒附魔的物品。它可用于增强千咒卷轴的效果，但你需要权衡这是否值得。此诅咒附魔也可通过装备附魔师的珍珠后在附魔台附魔时得到。

Applicable only to armor, this curse adds an aftermath to the damage you would take from your enemies. Severe debuffs will befall you for every hit that you take, the greater the damage - the greater the debuffs.<br2/>Hopefully, the chance of such happening is only about one in ten for every piece of armor with this curse that you bear.

pages.title: The Curse
pages.text: As per usual, you can occasionally find items bearing this curse among ancient treasures which you periodically pillage. It might be useful to power Scroll of a Thousand Curses if you have such, but whether or not the tradeoff is worth it is for you to judge.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.torrent_enchantment.page.1

pages.title: book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.torrent_enchantment.heading.1
pages.text: book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.torrent_enchantment.page.2
此附魔会增加三叉戟对这两种生物造成的伤害：免疫高温伤害的（比如烈焰人和僵尸猪灵）和怕水的（比如末影人）。<br2/>每级魔咒增加 2.5 伤害，就像亡灵杀手对亡灵那样。

pages.title: 附魔
pages.text: 此附魔与穿刺和愤怒属于同类别的附魔，因此与它们互斥。

This enchantment does increase damage your trident deals against both entities that are immune to fire (like Blazes or Zombified Piglins) and creatures which are sensitive to water (like Endermen).<br2/>Exact damage increase against matching creatures is +2.5 damage per level of enchantment, identical to that of Smite against undead.

pages.title: The Enchantment
pages.text: Also this enchantment falls under the same category as Impaling and Wrath, therefore being mutually exclusive with them.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.wrath_enchantment.page.1

pages.title: book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.wrath_enchantment.heading.1
pages.text: book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.wrath_enchantment.page.2
一个三叉戟专属的附魔，类似于剑和斧的锋利附魔，增加三叉戟造成的伤害。对近战和远程攻击均有效。

pages.title: 附魔
pages.text: 但是，它比锋利附魔更强，每一级愤怒附魔会增加 1.25 的伤害。<br2/>此附魔与穿刺以及激流属于同一类别，因此与它们互斥。

An enchantment exclusive to tridents, this one is very similar to effect Sharpness has on swords and axes, increasing damage your trident can deal against any foe in general. It works both when trident is used as a melee weapon and when it is thrown as a projectile.<br2/>Damage increase this enchantment offers is

pages.title: The Enchantment
pages.text: noticeably better than that of Sharpness however, as it provides +1.25 damage per level of enchantment applied.<br2/>This enchantment falls under the same category as Impaling and Torrent, therefore being mutually exclusive with them.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.abyssal_heart.page.1

pages.title: book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.abyssal_heart.heading.1
pages.text: book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.abyssal_heart.page.2
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.abyssal_heart.page.3
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.abyssal_heart.page.4
当这个超凡脱俗的可憎之物第一次落入你的手中时，难以言表的复杂情感充斥着你的大脑：恐怖、兴奋、钦佩、厌恶……它的独眼凝视着你，其意图无法理解。但一旦最初的情绪浪潮退去，你便断定它对你不构成威胁。

pages.title: 跳动的心脏
pages.text: 然而，你仍不知它为何物，来自何处。也许你难以忍受的存在，以及不顾七咒生存下去的努力被某种不可名状的邪恶存在注意到了。通过你这可憎的存在，祂将自己传送到这个世界中。
也许这只是一个意外，现实自身的漏洞使它侥幸出现在这个世界。也许是你病态的思想在某次梦魇般的狂热中构想出了这种恐怖，随着它逐渐成长，诅咒的腐化力量已设法使它在尘世显现。<br2/>也许最好永远不要知道——因为某些真相远超人类想象的尽头，令人惶恐不安。
无论如何，你现在是它的合法拥有者。用不了多久，你就会发现它无法想象的暴力的、恐怖的用途……世界强加于你的苦难，必将十倍奉还。

When this unearthly abomination fell into your hands for the first time, description-defying mix of feelings have overcome your mind, among which there was a place for terror and excitement, admiration and disgust. The gaze of its lonely eye befell you with intent impossible to comprehend, but once initial wave of emotions retreated - you have

pages.title: The Heart
pages.text: concluded that it poses no threat to you.<br2/>Still, you know not what it truly is, and where it came from. Perhaps your insufferable existence, and efforts to live in spite of Seven Curses were noticed by some unnameable eldritch power, and through your

damnable being it have chosen to channel itself into the world. Perhaps it is a mere accident, a fluke in reality itself that allowed something like this to appear. Perhaps it is your ailing mind that have conceived this horror in some nightmarish fever, and with its growth - corruption of the curses have managed to manifest it into the mortal realm?<br2/>Perhaps it's best to never know, for some truths are much

more unsettling than anything a man's imagination can come up with.<br2/>Regardless, now you are the rightful owner of this thing. And it will not be long before you can put it to some unimaginably violent, frightening use... The world will suffer tenfold for all the suffering it caused to you.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.ancient_debris.page.1

pages.title: book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.ancient_debris.heading.1
pages.text: book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.ancient_debris.page.2
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.ancient_debris.page.3
在下界的地壳深处，有一块远古残骸。它的起源尚不明确。<br2/>您找到的知识片段非常准确地描述了精炼过程以及可以通过这种方法获得的材料的预期特性，但是不知道它可能来自何处。

pages.title: 残骸
pages.text: 尽管下界的地质历史本身就是个谜，但与那些残骸在历史中所造成的异常情况相比，这更是一个谜。<br2/>但是，比起历史，您对手上的碎片本身更感兴趣。
你也知道，这可能是锻造硬度超过钻石的金属的关键，在此之前，钻石仍然是人类和半神们使用的最耐用的材料。

Deep within the Nether's crust, there lies an ancient debris.<br2/>Its origin isn't known exactly. Fragments of lore you came across quite precisely describe the process of refining it and expected properties of material that  can be obtained through doing so, but leave no clues to where  it could've come from. Though geological history of

pages.title: The Debris
pages.text: the Nether is a mystery in its own right, how something as unusual as those debris ended up in that history is even more of an enigma.<br2/>Much more than in that history, however, you are interested in laying your hands on the actual sample of debris itself.

From what you have acknowledged, it might be a key to forging metal that supersedes hardness of a diamond, which for many former eons remained the most durable material both humans and demigods had to work with.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.astral_dust.page.1

pages.title: book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.astral_dust.heading.1
pages.text: book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.astral_dust.page.2
隐藏在末地城的房间里，这种难以捉摸的物质具有迷人的特性。所有元素之力似乎都混合在其中，以某种方式使自己保持相对稳定。星尘在世界初始时，是混乱无常的，随着时间推移冷却下来，使你可以看到他的美丽瞬间。

pages.title: Za Dusto
pages.text: 它拥有强大的的奥术力量，但是需要经过一番谨慎的处理与细致的塑型，才能从它的混沌之中生发秩序，使其潜在的使用价值变为现实。随着时间的流逝，你肯定会发现它有非常多的用处。

Concealed within the rooms of End Cities, this elusive substance does possess incredibly interesting properties. Power of all elements seems to be infused and mixed within it, somehow holding itself in relatively stable form. Astral Dust resembles creation itself, chaotic and impermanent, yet somehow frozen in time, allowing you to behold all

pages.title: Za Dusto
pages.text: beauty of its single instant.<br2/>The arcane power that it holds might be immense, but it requires to be carefully treated and molded to be useful in a constructive way. As time goes by, however, there is no doubt you will discover many possible applications it can have.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.cosmic_heart.page.1
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.cosmic_heart.page.2
精心挑选蕴藏其它维度力量的神秘原料，你将能够改变海洋之心的尘世本质，将其转变为不同的东西……它将蕴含超凡的力量。<br2/>寰宇之力现在就在你的手中。
随着时间流逝，你将知晓它会助你达成怎样的难以想象的壮举，它足以扭曲现实的能量会创造出怎样绝妙的神器。<br2/>但有一件事毋庸置疑——世界将在其持有者脚下颤栗。

With a fine selection of arcane ingredients, those which contain the power of other dimensions, you can alter the earthly nature of Heart of the Sea, transforming it into something different... Vastly more powerful.<br2/>The power of cosmos itself now rests at the palm of your hand. Only time will tell what unimaginable feats can be
achieved with it, what fabulous artifacts can be powered with its reality-bending energies.<br2/>But one thing is for certain - the world will tremble beneath the steps of their bearer.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.earth_heart.page.1

pages.title: book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.earth_heart.heading.1
pages.text: book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.earth_heart.page.2
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.earth_heart.page.3
与海洋之心的存在类似——也就是那个与覆盖主世界的无尽海洋相关的东西——大地之心诞生于岩底深处，其内蕴含了一些大地的原生能量。<br2/>它可以在主世界地表以下极深处找到，就在那地牢的房间与走廊之中静静等候着，逸失于沉闷窒息的黑暗之中，被人遗忘。

pages.title: 心
pages.text: 这个心脏拥有的元素之力与储存在术石中的相似，不同的是，它并不发源于原初之混沌，原初混沌谱写出了大千世界的开端。大地之心乃是很久之后才诞生的，在地壳中经历了沧海桑田方凝结而出。
大地之心万古凝结而出的形体并不适合佩戴，想要自由地引导存储在其中未精炼的能量也相当困难，但是如果你使用得当，它可以充当需要此类强大能量的遗物的核心。

Similar to how there is Heart of the Sea, an item bound with nature of endless oceans and seas covering surface of the Overworld, there is Heart of the Earth, born within its rocky depths and encapsulating some of their raw energy. It can be found in deepest rooms and halls of dungeons deep below the Overworld's surface, lost and forgotten in smothering darkness.

pages.title: The Heart
pages.text: The elemental power this heart holds bears resemblance to that stored within spellstones, but unlike latter it isn't originated from primordial chaos that spelled the beginning of all worlds, instead being born much later, slowly condensating in the earth's crust during many geological eons.

The resulting shape doesn't attend its bearer and does not allow to freely channel unrefined energy stored within, but may serve as core for powerful relics requiring such energy if utilized properly.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.ender_rod.page.1
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.ender_rod.page.2
向 §6烈焰棒$(clear) 注入 §5星尘$(clear) 的力量，你将可以制作该棍。<br2/>它将来会有更多作用，但目前主要功能是将其作为锻造以太工具的手柄基座，因为普通的木材已经无法满足需求了。

Infusing Blaze Rod with enderic energy and power contained within Astral Dust, you shall be able to craft this rod.<br2/>It might have more applications in the future, but you have primarily designed it as base for forging handles for etherium tools, as mundane wood would not suffice for  that sake anymore.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.etherium.page.1
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.etherium.page.2
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.etherium.page.3
名字听起来虚无缥缈，但本身却又相当坚固。<br2/>那些传言居然是真的，甚至更甚，他们并没有夸大事实。你曾从别人那听过关于以太金属的只言片语，它真的就似那般所说，具有很多奇妙的特性。它具有很高的熔点，下界合金般的抗火和抗熔岩能力，还具有更高的耐久。
除此之外，这种金属的内部的脉冲能量简直就要溢出来了，你脑中思绪迸发，恨不得将其制作为你能想到的所有工具和装备，试试效果究竟如何。<br2/>贤主遇良才，这种金属对于形态塑造的适应性相当强，无论是什么形状都能轻松适应。
这个世界很快就会看到你新锻造的功能强大的以太工具。

Despite the name is has, this material is physically solid. Very.<br2/>Stories have turned out to be true. And even more - they were not exaggerating the truth. Etherium truly has most of the wondrous properties that were assigned to it by pieces of lore you happened across earlier. It has quite high melting point, being just

as resistant to fire and lava as netherite is, while significantly superseding its durability. Apart from that, this metal is overfilled with pulsing energy, urging you to unleash it in any shape or form you can come up with.<br2/>And for being alike you, capability to create shape and form is beyond questioning.
This world will soon behold the might of your newly forged etherium tools.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.etherium_ore.page.1

pages.title: book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.etherium_ore.heading.1
pages.text: book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.etherium_ore.page.2
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.etherium_ore.page.3
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.etherium_ore.page.4
在来自末地的所有奥秘中，有一个东西比其他任何都更能吸引你的注意力。传言说它是一个以太为名的超凡的材料。<br2/>需要注意的是，以太并不是由末地岛屿地壳运动生成的，而似乎是由远古文明殖民者留下的。但那个文明统治的时期已经是很久之前的事了，所以你不可能问他们这是怎么做到的。

pages.title: 矿石
pages.text: 理论上，他们可能成功利用了某种压倒性的非常强大的能量，将这种矿物显现出物理实现来制作他们。可惜，你不能确定他们的真正的制作方法是什么样子，如果你看到他们的实验论文，那可能会知道更多。
除了科学研究，法师和铁匠也对这材料很感兴趣。<br2/>如果这种材料没有那么多奇妙的描述，你可能会怀疑这些描述是否正确。
除却纯粹的科学兴趣外，身为一名巫师兼工匠，你更希望能够深入研究这种金属，因为这种材料的性质被流行的说法夸上天了，而且各有各的说法，所以你相当怀疑这些说法真实性。

Among all other mysteries that originate from The End, one draws your attention more than any other. It is rumored that there you can happen across an exquisite material, bearing the name of etherium.<br2/>It's worth noting that etherium is always referred to as something you can't happen across naturally within end islands' crust, and yet somehow

pages.title: The Ore
pages.text: it's implied this material ended up in possession of ancient civilization than once attempted to colonize this dimension.<br2/>Since days of reign of that civilization are long since over, you cannot ask them how that is possible. You currently theorize that they might've

succedeed in harnessing overwhelming amounts of enderic energies, and used them to manifest this mineral into physical reality, thus being able to manufacture it.<br2/>You can't really be sure how their methods looked like, unfortunately, but should you behold the conclusions of their works, some more answers might reveal themselves. Apart from purely scientific interest, you are much more interested in it as both mage and
blacksmith, since properties of this materials are often described in a way so wondrous you would doubt these descriptions are true,  if only there wasn't so many  of them around.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.evil_essence.page.1

pages.title: book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.evil_essence.heading.1
pages.text: book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.evil_essence.page.2
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.evil_essence.page.3
下界之星乃是凋灵物理身体的核心，而这一物质则是它那不朽灵魂的外显物，其物理构成乃是一些纯粹的能量。粗看上去，这团能量只是一些细小的碎块，但当你把它放在手中时，你却能感受到其中的无穷潜能。

pages.title: 精髓
pages.text: 当你接近时，他会因为想要附在你身上而表现的扭曲起来。也许你可以允许它这样做？不，那将是一个愚蠢的决定。
但有一件事毋庸置疑：这一物质内含的黑暗与扭曲之力难以估量，而你恰好又能操纵这种力量。你肯定能找到某种方法来利用它。

While the Nether Star is a core of Wither's physical vessel, this substance is a manifestation of pure energy of its seemingly indestructible and perpetual soul. A tiny fraction of that energy, but it sure has immeasurable potential in your hands.<br2/>It seems to have strange connection to your own cursed being, which is why you were

pages.title: The Essence
pages.text: able to obtain this essence in the first place. It draws closer to you as you approach, as if bent by desire to latch onto you. Perhaps, you could allow it to do so?... No, what a dumb idea that would be.<br2/>But one thing is beyond questioning - this matter contains tremendous amounts
of dark, twisted power, that you just so happen to be capable of harnessing. You will surely find something to do with it.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.netherite.page.1
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.netherite.page.2
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.netherite.page.3
尽管事实证明远残骸非常罕见且难以定位，但很难说他它不值得。<br2/>通过将其熔炼成碎片并小心地将碎片与金融合，你可以制作出称为下界合金锭的材料。它不仅可以抵抗下界的高温，还能够承受火焰或浸没在熔岩中而没有任何损坏，而且比钻石坚硬得多。
事实证明，它并不是钻石的完美替代品，但它可以以钻石为基础打造出更精致的复合物，效果最好。
你可以肯定，在以其为基底的复合材料中，这种材料并不是最优秀的，因此你还会 继续尝试使用这种金属来尝试创造出更出色的材料。

Though Ancient Debris has turned out to be quite rare and difficult to locate, it's hard to claim that it isn't worth it.<br2/>By smelting it into scrap and carefully fusing that scrap with gold, you can create material known as Netherite. Not only it is resistant to high temperatures of the Nether, capable to survive

being exposed to flames or submerged in lava without any significant damage, but it also is much harder than diamond.<br2/>It has proven to work best not as complete substitute to diamond, however, but as part

of more exquisite compound with diamond serving as its base.<br2/>It must be assumed that this might not be the most effective composite it can go into creation of, so you keep experimenting with this metal in an attempt to create material that could have even more outstanding qualities.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.twisted_heart.page.1
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.twisted_heart.page.2
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.twisted_heart.page.3
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.twisted_heart.page.4
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.twisted_heart.page.5
因此，是你，你选择了这一命运。你肯定已经知道，在此漫漫长途中，这种选择会给你造成多少痛苦和遗憾，但是你依然选择了这条路。但是，你究竟知不知道你这样选择的缘由？<br2/>无论如何，你已经没有退路，只有前进，才能利用你现在所受的诅咒之力。
希望这项任务不会像它看上去那样复杂，当然，若是忽略掉原料获取这一环节的话。之所以这么说，是因为诅咒本身正在积极寻求新方法将腐化蔓延到你周围的世界，它们只需要你的一点小小的帮助。
一旦你得到了“大地之心”，你就会发现它能够与戒指的黑暗力量共鸣，心内的纯净能量会因此搏动加快。这种影响力度较弱，不足以立即污染大地之心，因此使其无法用于常规制作。
但是，通过一些精心选择的魔法原料以及少量的半神之力，你可以加强心与你所承受的诅咒之间的联系，从而使前者腐化并转变为完全不同的物品。<br2/>扭曲之心就是这种邪恶仪式的产物，这一工艺品乃是强大诅咒的具象化，比大地之心所包含的东西更黑暗，更强大。
它不能代替大地之心的作用，但它肯定会有自己的用武之地。

...and thus, it was you who have chosen this fate. You have surely acknowledged what sorrow and regret this choice will cost you many times in the long journey ahead, but you still have done it. Do you even know why?<br2/>Regardless, there is no way back - only ahead, in an attempt to harness the power of great curses you are now

bound with. This task is hopefully not as complicated as it might seem if you can gain access to required ingredients, as curses themselves seem to actively seek new ways to spread tendrils of their corruption

into the world around you - they just require a little assistance from you.<br2/>As soon as you laid claim upon Heart of the Earth, you have noticed that it resonates with dark power of the ring, setting pulsations of pure energy within it slightly out of tact. This influence is hopefully not strong enough to instantly tarnish the heart, therefore rendering it unusable for regular crafting. But with small amount of carefully selected

arcane ingredients and a fraction of your demigod power involved, you can reinforce the link between the heart's core and curses that you bear, allowing latter to corrupt it and transform into something entirely different.<br2/>Twisted Heart is a product of this unholy ritual, an artifact incarnating part of the great curse, darker and more powerful than what Heart of the Earth used to contain.
It cannot be used for purposes Heart of the Earth was useful for, but it surely will have its own applications.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.animal_guidebook.page.1
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.animal_guidebook.page.2
如果您想与主世界里可爱的动物们交朋友，这份全面的指南肯定会为您提供帮助。它能帮助你在战斗时避免伤害到你的动物朋友，以及许多获得忠诚和尊重的方法。<br2/>你很难牢记其中数百页这个主题的理论和研究，因此最好随身携带，以便您需要快速查找一些知识。

If you seek to befriend lovely fauna of the Overworld, this comprehensive guide will certainly help you in doing so. It will help you learn how to avoid accidentally hurting your animal friends when busy fighting something much less friendly, and many ways to earn their loyalty and respect.<br2/>It's difficult to remember hundreds of pages filled
with careful research and outlining details on the topic however, so better carry it around with yourself, just in case you will need to look up a thing or two real quick.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.astral_potato.page.1
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.astral_potato.page.2
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.astral_potato.page.3
在胡萝卜狂热粉和土豆私生饭的持久战中，后者发现他们注定处于劣势。毕竟烤马铃薯除了美味毫无优点。但仅仅一根金胡萝卜就蕴含巨大的营养价值以及恢复活力的作用。现在，我们将说“莫欺土豆穷！”。融合宇宙之力的最新烹饪发明将实现两个目的：填饱肚子，并成为我们在胡萝卜——土豆战争中至高无上的象征。
给这种美味佳肴绝妙的名字，我们将狠狠嘲弄敌人，挫败他们的士气。被“传送薯”彻底击败，他们将感到何等羞耻！
他们脸上会浮现出怎样惊惧的神情？<br2/>我们很快就会知道了……

In the everlasting battle of carrot lovers against potato enjoyers, the latter were bound to find themselves at a steady disadvantage. After all, what is a baked potato, in spite of all its deliciousness, in the face of immense nutritional value and reinvigorating effects of a mere carrot, albeit covered in some gold?

Today, we say "no more". The latest culinary invention of the cosmos itself shall fulfill two purposes - satiating our hunger, and becoming a symbol of our supremacy in the war on carrot. The appropriate name we have given to this

great delicacy will no doubt further mock and demoralize our enemy. What a shame would it be for them to find out they were utterly defeated by "Teleportato"? What horror will such awareness paint upon their faces?<br2/>It won't be long before we find out...
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.cosmic_cake.page.1
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.cosmic_cake.page.2
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.cosmic_cake.page.3
终将迎来终末——这一致命缺点决定了尘世间的蛋糕无法臻于极致，就如凡人的性命那般。但最终，你想出了一个妙招来改正这一恼人的缺陷，让你能永远纵享其奶油的丝滑。
这个蛋糕被赋予了原初之力，融合了外星美味与元素能量。它无视时间流逝，逆转了熵，会随逐渐恢复自身。
无论你多么屈服于暴食之罪，它总会从你的无尽贪食之中恢复。面对如此美味，谁能拒绝以权力、影响、财富甚至生命本身来换取沉浸在无休止摄食行为之中的机会？<br2/>万物终将归于尘土……唯有此物恒久长青。

There is only one issue in the mundane cake, one final flaw that prevents it from becoming perfect - it always ends, as imminently as life of a mortal man. At last, you conceived a way to rectify this annoying imperfection, letting you enjoy its creamy grace forevermore.<br2/>Imbued with primordial power, incorporating alien delicacy and spiced up with elemental

energies, this cake defies the flow of time, reversing entropy itself to restore its glorious, palatable form. However much you submit yourself to the sin of gluttony, it will always recover from any devouring assault of yours.

Who can withstand in the face of such deliciousness, who can resist the desire to exchange power, influence, riches and even life itself for becoming submerged in ceaseless, infinite act of consumption? Those things are temporary after all... but the cake, the cake is eternal.
book.enigmaticlegacy.entry.curse_transposer.page.1

但有时处理附魔还是很麻烦，因为即使你能在物品之间转移附魔，目前你还是无法分离常规附魔和诅咒附魔。
然而，有了这个小发明，你处理诅咒附魔的能力显著提高了。它提供了一种仅仅转移诅咒附魔的方法。虽然这个方法并不便宜，但聊胜于无。

But they still are a great nuisance at times, as even though you can transpose them from one item from another, so far you had no way of separating them from
enchantments when doing so.<br2/>With this little invention, however, your curse management abilities should improve significantly. It offers a way to separate curses and only curses from any item of
your equipment; not a cheap one at that, but a way nonetheless.

当你选择戴上“七咒之戒”时，你考虑过摆脱它的可能性，即使不是真的要这么做，但至少要知道它的可能性。尽管其锻造材料并非坚不可摧，但戒指的物理化身只是自然力量的一小部分。腐败的触手深入到你的灵魂深处，将不朽的你与戒指交织在一起，因此而产生了这些诅咒与祝福。
此乃你们之间的联系如此稳固的原因，甚至是死亡中也不会解除。
你可以在一定程度上从戒指内部吸取力量，戒指也可以从你内部吸取力量以增强其物理形态，牢牢固定在手指上。<br2/>似乎能影响这些联系的只有极高的热量，但那样无法在保证自身安全的情况下将其断开。
但如果你击败了凋灵并收获了其掉落的邪恶精髓，你将有能力克服这种障碍。邪恶之石象征着你与七咒之戒之间的联系，以某种形式贴近石头，易碎的物理效果将会表现出来。从而允许你利用戒指的漏洞，用某种特殊的仪式使其自我毁灭。
要使用这块石头，需要前往炽热和失落的灵魂，被称为下界的维度。尽你所能的漫步在支离破碎的景观，攀登悬崖峭壁，在边缘俯视，直到发现脚下有熔岩海。深呼吸一口，然后一跃迈进下面炽热的熔岩海中间，让你的身体沉没在熔岩海里被烧死。
如果一切正确执行，戒指应被融化并永久摧毁。
但从绑定中解放的代价并不便宜，因为你通过邪恶之石暴露了与你的灵魂以之纠缠的部分。为了使仪式成功，必须先销毁这一部分，否则仪式根本不可能成功。至少有了这种牺牲，你再也不会看到七咒之戒了，除非你的世界中还有其他七咒之戒，这几乎不可能。

Ever since you have chosen to bear the Ring of the Seven Curses, you pondered the possibility of getting rid of it - if not to actually do this, then at least to be aware if it exists. Though materials it is forged from are by no measure indestructible, physical incarnation of the ring is just a mere fraction of its metaphysical power and nature. Tendrils of its corruption
reach deep within your soul, intertwining your immortal being with entity of the ring itself, and thus all curses and blessings it yields.<br2/>This connection between you is exactly what makes it so

persistent, inseparable from you even in death. As much as to certain extent you are able to draw and harness power from within the ring, the ring is capable of drawing power from within you in order to reinforce its physical form, as well as the link tightly holding that form on your finger. The only thing it seems to remain barely susceptible to would appear to be extreme heat, but that connection ensures it cannot be permanently destroyed without

your own body being destroyed just as permanently. And since you apparently possess the ability to create and inhabit new vessel after destruction of the old one, the ring does either.<br2/>However, now that you defeated the Wither and harvested sheer essence of its corrupted soul, the possibility to surmount such obstacle revealed itself. The Unholy Stone symbolizes the connection between you and Ring of the Seven Curses,

manifested and exposed in somewhat fragile physical form for as long as you keep the stone close to you. This allows you to exploit ring's only vulnerability, by willingly meeting your demise in specific, somewhat ritualistic manner.<br2/>With this stone at your disposal, travel to the dimension of blazing heat and lost souls, known as the Nether. Wander amongst its blasted, twisted landscape,

climbing cliffs and ledges to look down from them - until you discover an ocean of seething lava beneath your feet, as vast and deep as you can find. Hold your breath for a while, before releasing it for the last time, and leap into the midst of blazing ocean below, letting your body drown into the molten rock and be consumed by fire.<br2/>Should everything be executed correctly, the ring shall melt and be destroyed forever.

The liberation from its chains doesn't come cheap, however - it is only possible because you expose part of your soul entangled with it through the Unholy Stone. In order for this ritual to be successful, that part must be destroyed first, otherwise it would simply not be possible. But at least with this sacrifice made you will never see that cursed ring again... unless of course it would turn out there was more than one in your world, which is not very likely.

这本书本身并没有什么神秘的知识和力量，但其最大的愿望就是获得一些知识。<br2/>如果你将它与任何附魔物品紧密接触，它将立即吸收这些附魔，就像任何普通附魔书一样存储它们。
原附魔的物品会保持完好无损，在整个过程中不会被损坏，除了附魔被求知之书吸收了之外，所有物品都保持不变。
你可以正常使用获得的求知之书。满足了它的饥饿感后，它沉寂了下来，外显属性与通常的附魔书并无二致。

This book does not hold much arcane knowledge or power on its own, but it seems like its greatest desire is to get some.<br2/>If you allow it to come in close contact with any enchanted item, it will instantly absorb these enchantments, storing them as any normal enchanted book would. The item remains completely intact and
undamaged in process - everything about it stays the same, besides enchantments that were absorbed.<br2/>You can use the resulting book as you would normally - having its hunger satisfied, it seems
to lose any properties that would make it different from any other enchanting book.

即便末地如此贫瘠荒凉，仍有人想定居于此。原因有二：寻求某物，或躲避某物。直到最近，定居末地仍有不便之处。但维度锚解决了在末地绑定重生点的难题。<br2/>
维度锚的工作方式与重生锚并无不同，不过需要末影珍珠代替廉价的荧石进行充能。
高昂的维护成本也有补偿——维度锚能在重生锚无法工作的地点生效，并且有一定几率在重生时不消耗充能。召回药水也能回到维度锚设置的重生点，发射器也能用于充能维度锚。
只有一件事仍值得考虑。即便对于高等存在而言，在维度之间穿梭仍是危险的，对于那些脱离肉体的存在更甚。你不禁去想，何等可怖的地方等待着那些被它们的信标光束误导的人们，迷失之地将会赐予他们怎样可怕的命运。

However barren and desolate lands of The End are, there exist reasons why one could want to dwell there. Mostly two - to seek something, or to hide from something. Until recently there was a minor inconvenience getting in the way of such desires, but with invention of Dimensional Anchor the challenge of binding the point of your resurrection to somewhere
within those lands is finally overcome.<br2/>Dimensional Anchor works in the manner not dissimilar to that of Respawn Anchor, but will require Ender Pearls to be recharged instead of much

cheaper Glowstone. As a repayment for increased maintenance costs - it can function where Respawn Anchor cannot, and has a noticeable chance to not spend a charge upon your revival. Things such as Potion of Recall will work with it much as they do with its predecessor, and Dispenser can still be used to automate recharging.<br2/>Only one thing remains of concern. Even for higher beings, space between worlds

is not the safest of places to traverse, most so when stripped of flesh... You cannot help but wonder what terrible places await those who are mislead by the light of their beacons, and what grisly fate befalls them in there.

你经常会遇到不介意带回家的生物，以便更好的对其进行的研究，或者将它们作为宠物或牲畜饲养。<br2/>但即使是最温顺的动物，在进行远距离运送时也是极为困难——即使他们乐意跟随你。它们走的很慢，几乎不会绕开障碍，而且一不留神，它们很可能会迷路。
但假如你使用这颗眼睛的力量，处理这些生物将变得非常简单。首先你需要绑定目的地，然后走到任何生物旁并利用眼睛的力量使它消失在空气中，生物将出现在目的地。
可惜眼睛使用后会消失，不会跟着生物传送到目的地。你无法确定它到底会去哪里，因为一旦它消失了，就根本没有任何痕迹存在于物理现实中。

You often come across creatures you wouldn't mind to take back home with you, for either closer research on them, or to keep them around as pets, or as livestock.<br2/>But even the most docile animals prove to be extremely difficult to deliver over vast distances - even when they willingly follow you, they are slow, almost completely

incapable of finding their way around obstacles, and will most certainly get lost if you don't pay attention.<br2/>But having one of these eyes at your disposal can render the task of getting almost any

creature where you want it to be to action as simple as unleashing the eye's power. You will first require to bind the eye to location that will be the destination. You can then walk up to any creature and use the power of the eye on it to make it vanish into thin air, appearing at the destination point.<br2/>Unfortunately, the eye itself also vanishes in process, and unlike the creature you are transporting - never makes it
to the final destination. You are still uncertain on where exactly it goes, as once it vanishes there is no trace of it ever being present in a physical reality at all.

另一本综合指南，将帮助您学习如何与驯服的野兽并肩作战。您可能已经意识到，尽管它们在战斗中表现得忠诚和勇猛，但动物的感知力却比您低得多，并且无法开发复杂的战术并有效地躲开粗暴的攻击。
此书概述了许多独特的作战方法，教会你训练他们，使你承受他们所受到的攻击，从而避免他们因承受了无法承受的攻击而战死。
希望您的防御手段更加细致有效，例如在战斗中使用药水的更快地治愈自己。

Another comprehensive guide, this one will help you learn how to hunt side-by-side with beastly companions that you might have tamed. You are probably already aware that despite all loyalty and courage they are capable of showing in battle, animals are much less sentient than you and aren't capable of developing complex combat techniques and effectively
dodging obscure attack patterns.<br2/>This book outlines many unique approaches to combat that you can learn as their master, which will allow you to take hits they normally would on

yourself, saving them from being slain by attacks stronger than they can bear.<br2/>Hopefully your means of defense are much more elaborate and effective, and you can heal yourself much quicker in battle with use potions for instance.

另一种利用大地之心力量的方法，这种神秘的物质体现了大自然自身的力量，它非常渴望将其根基散布在整个大陆上，无论如何成长和繁衍。<br2/>狂野生长精华可以使大多数植物生命显着加速生长，类似于使用骨粉时产生的效果。
但是，与骨粉不同，您只需要一个即可起到这种效果。它似乎能够从周围的自然环境吸收力量，在使用后能够不断补充自身的能量，虽然不会超过最初制作出来时的能量。
它也可用于某些普通肥料不起作用的植物，尤其是是甘蔗、仙人掌、藤蔓和下界疣。

One another way to harness the power that rests within Heart of the Earth, this arcane substance embodies the power of nature itself, with its everlasting desire to spread its roots across the earth, to grow and thrive no matter what.<br2/>Letting it come in contact with most forms of plantlife is enough to significantly

accelerate their growth, similar to the effect produced when using Bone Meal. Unlike Bone Meal, however, you only need a mere grains of it to achieve such effect. Left alone, it seems to be able to draw power from surrounding

nature, growing and replenishing itself in quantity after being used - though never to more than there was created originally.<br2/>It also works on certain plants that normal fertilizers have no effect on, specifically Sugar Cane, Cacti, Vines and Nether Wart.

设计师的墨水是编写文本的绝佳工具。它可以让人联想起星光般生动的色彩，并且它刻画的符号永不消退，除非你完全销毁它们所驻留的表面。
为了真正利用它，你首先需要制作“物品描述片段”，一种特殊的羊皮纸，非常合适用于容纳你的作品。
这些片段可以单独存储文本，你可以将写在上面的文字转移到几乎任何东西上，使你的原始物品变得更精致。<br2/>以下页面包含更详细的使用说明。

pages.title: 界面
pages.text: 墨水池允许你打开上述展示的界面。
将你的“物品描述片段”放到输入槽<&c><&l>(1)$(clear)。然后在上方的本文框<&c><&l>(3)$(clear)内输入你所需的名称和Lore。<br2/>有许多特殊的格式代码会作为隐形文本，但会影响随后所有文字的颜色和格式，或指定你要对某一行文本行的操作。

如果你想将本文作为物品描述而不是物品名字，则需加上前缀 "<&5><&l>!$(clear)" 。每条添加的物品描述都具有增量索引，该索引定义了它相对其他物品描述的位置。初始索引为<&l>0$(clear)。<br2/>如果你要替换指定索引的物品描述，你可以在 "<&5><&l>!$(clear)" 后面添加索引。例如，如果你像将添加的物品描述替换掉第三行，格式将会是这样 "<&5><&l>!2$(clear)" 。
如果你要删除最后添加的物品描述，只需输入 "<&5><&l>-!$(clear)" 到本文框。如果你想删除指定索引处的物品描述，需要在 "<&5><&l>-!$(clear)" 后面添加索引。例如，如果你要删除第五条物品描述，你需要输入 "<&5><&l>-!4$(clear)" 。<br2/>当你输入没有格式代码作为前缀时，它将用于重命名该物品。
颜色和格式代码，不像前缀代码，它可以添加在本文框任何位置，并将其效果应用于所有在其后方的文本。使用颜色代码时，它将之后所有文本的颜色更改为它代表的颜色。如果稍后再加上其他颜色代码，则最后一个颜色代码后方的本文颜色将覆盖之前所有颜色代码的效果；以允许对行中的不同单词或部分文本使用多种颜色。
最后输入的颜色代码将始终对其后的所有内容生效，直到被另一种颜色代码覆盖为止。<br2/>另一方面，格式代码不会相互覆盖，并且可以与颜色代码叠加在一起。例如，你可以用 "<&5><&l>&4&l&o$(clear)" 来制作 <&4><&l><&o>暗红 + 加粗 + 斜体$(clear) 本文效果。
字体格式一直有效直到应用了任何颜色格式为止;任何在字体格式代码之后应用的颜色代码都会完全清除字体格式。因此，字体格式必须始终在颜色格式之后添加，才能做到将其叠堆在一起。<br2/>以下还有颜色和字体代码的准确描述，可以直观地显示其效果。

The Architect's Inkwell is a wonderful tool for writing text. It can conjure colors vivid as the starlight, and symbols inscribed with it can never be erased, unless you completely destroy they surface they reside upon.<br2/>To actually make use out of it, you will first require to create Lore Fragment - special type of parchment that
perfectly fits to contain your writings.<br2/>These fragments can store the text on their own, but you can transfer the writings you inscribed upon them on virtually any other item,
conveying them to any human or demigod that may come to hold them in a way much more exquisite than primitive engravement.<br2/>Following pages contain more detailed usage instructions.

pages.title: The GUI
pages.text: The inkwell allows to access GUI similar to the above.

Put your Lore Fragment in the input slot <&c><&l>(1)$(clear). You will then be able to spell desired name and lore in the text field <&c><&l>(3)$(clear) above it.<br2/>There is a number of special formatting codes that will not be included as a part of visible text, but will instead allow to affect color/font formatting of any following writing, or specify operation that you want to perform with the text line.

If you want your text line to be added as a lore line instead of item name, prefix it with "<&5><&l>!$(clear)". Every line of lore added has incremental index that defines its position among other lore lines. Indexing starts with <&l>0$(clear).<br2/>If you want to replace lore line at specific index, you can specify the index after "<&5><&l>!$(clear)" symbol. For instance, if you want to replace third lore line on the fragment with the line you're adding, prefix will

look like "<&5><&l>!2$(clear)".<br2/>If you want to remove the last lore line added, simply enter "<&5><&l>-!$(clear)" in the text field. If you instead want to erase lore line at given index, specify that index right after the "<&5><&l>-!$(clear)". For instance, if you want to erase fifth line of lore, you will have to enter "<&5><&l>-!4$(clear)".<br2/>When you enter text line with no operational code as prefix, it will be used to rename the item.

Color and font codes, unlike operational codes, can be entered anywhere in the text field, and will apply their effect to all text that goes in the field after them. When using a color code, it will change color of all following text to the one it represents. If it is followed by another color code later, that last one will override the effect of all previous ones for everything that goes after it; this allows to use multiple colors for different words or parts of

the text in the line. The last color code entered will always take effect over anything that follows it, until it is overridden by another color.<br2/>Font codes, on the other hand, do not override one another and thus can be stacked together with one another, and with color codes if specified after them. For instance, you can use "<&5><&l>&4&l&o$(clear)" to create <&4><&l><&o>Dark Red + Bolded + Italic$(clear) text style after it.

Font formatting holds effect until any color formatting is applied after it; any color codes that are applied later than font codes clear font formatting completely. Therefore, font formatting always must be specified after color formatting in case you wish to stack it on top of that.<br2/>Further are precise descriptions of color and font codes, that visually demonstrate their effect.
